title: The Customer Is the Builder: How AI Coding Agents Are Rewriting the Economics of Software
abstract: arXiv:2610.30307v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI coding agents could change whether organizations buy software or build the functionality they need. We focus on organizations and professional buyers whose domain knowledge can help them specify and evaluate tools for their work. We define the software substitution frontier as the functions customers could build and maintain at an acceptable standard for less than buying them. Using public data, we compare growing capacity to build with indicators of market change. Since 2023, the length of benchmark tasks that leading agents can complete at 50 percent success, measured in human working time, has doubled about every 129 days. A broad search identified 575 potential open-source alternatives to selected commercial products, although some functional matches still require independent validation. translated_title: 客户即建造者：AI 编程智能体如何重写软件经济学
translated_abstract: AI 编程智能体可能会改变组织“购买软件”还是“自行构建所需功能”的决策。我们聚焦于组织及专业买家，他们的领域知识能够帮助其为自己工作中使用的工具进行规格说明与评估。我们定义了“软件替代前沿”，即客户能够以低于购买成本的方式构建并维护、且达到可接受标准的功能集合。利用公开数据，我们将不断增长的构建能力与市场变化指标进行对比。自2023年以来，领先智能体以50%成功率所能完成的基准任务时长（以人类工作时间衡量）大约每129天翻一番。通过一项广泛的检索，我们为选定的商业产品识别出575个潜在的开源替代方案，尽管其中部分功能匹配仍需独立验证。Craft 套件在12.0天的公开开发中产出了12个应用程序代码库，但这些仍属早期版本，其完整性尚未得到验证。
tldr: 本文提出“软件替代前沿”这一新概念，并发现AI编程智能体的能力约每129天翻一番、已识别出575个潜在开源替代方案，表明客户“自建而非购买”的软件经济模式正在被重写。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the concept of the "software substitution frontier" and shows that, with AI coding agents' capabilities doubling roughly every 129 days and 575 potential open-source alternatives already identified, the economics of software is shifting from buying to building.
